correctness.rationale: For m,n>=1 and target alpha>=m, let k=alpha+1,d=n+1. Two letter permutations on B=[k]xZ_d are a=(sigma,1), b=(tau,0) with sigma k-cycle and tau transposition. The first-coordinate permutation of ab is a (k−1)-cycle fixing one vertex, so a^k and (ab)^(k−1) yield pure counter shifts k and k−1; gcd 1 generates all Z_d for arbitrary d and hence full S_k x Z_d. Reachability and pairwise state-distinguishability show inputs have exactly m,n finals in their minimal DFAs; accepted B suffix projections equal Stab(k), whose preimage union of F_A is [k−1], yielding quotient asc=alpha and minimality. Low alpha<m follows published unary positive range [1,mn] using duplicate binary letter; empty cases are zero and nonemptiness excludes zero for m,n>0. Independent group closures for (k,d)=(2,2),(3,3),(4,3),(5,2) reproduced k!d and stabilizer sizes. Infinite claim follows coprime shifts, not enumeration.
